feeds.title: Life with Aspergers
feeds.description: The goal of this blog is to describe what it is like living with Asperger's Syndrome and to focus on the positive aspects of the condition rather than the negative. The overall aim of this blog is to increase the amount of first-hand knowledge about Asperger's syndrome and to encourage other to accept and embrace it within themselves and others.

feeds.title: My ASD Child
feeds.description: A blog about raising children and teens with Asperger's and High-Functioning Autism.

feeds.title: Dr Tony Attwood Blog
feeds.description: Professor Tony Attwood is considered to be one of the world's foremost experts on Autism Spectrum Disorder. This site is a guide for parents, professionals, and people with Asperger's Syndrome or Autism Spectrum Disorder Level 1 and their partners.

feeds.title: Raven Ambition's Aspergers BLOG
feeds.description: Raven Ambition's Aspergers blog share life's idiosyncratic observation. Reflection with an Asperger's viewpoint.

feeds.title: Aspiepriest
feeds.description: I am a Roman Catholic Priest with Asperger's Syndrome ponders the Catholic Faith and human nature. I am writing this blog for other autistic readers, for anyone who has an autistic friend, and for scholars whose work touches on human nature.
